name: Nedbank Group Limited
note: South African banking group with its primary listing on the JSE (2025 Integrated Report). Its largest named shareholder in the dataset's claims is Old Mutual, which held a 19.9% minority stake through Old Mutual Life Assurance Company South Africa Limited (OMLACSA) as stated for the 2018 unbundling; whether that stake still holds in 2026 was not separately sourced.
